body:
Quick pass (coordinator, read only, no build) on head `ebfcedf5e`: the PR is a sub-PR of `side/path-kernel` and merges cleanly with it. It adds recorded baselines and their pins; it changes no planner code. The author's gate is green on this head: the quick gate (1219 steps, 0 failed), clippy and the light lane. The body starts with `Side branch: side/path-kernel`, has the `Goldens moved` list and ends with `Refs #4153`. The PR is flagged ready. It waits for the independent review.

Notes for the reviewer:
- The trial merge and the gate base are `origin/side/path-kernel`, not `main`.
- The PR changes one existing test, `crates/cl/tests/headless_bin.rs` (`cl_text_round_trips_every_golden`), because the new goldens end with note lines. PR #4123 has the identical hunk, so the two PRs merge in either order. Check that the test is not weaker.
- Check that each golden is an addition and that the pins are deterministic (the author ran them two times).
